title: Mon 02 Nov 2026: Tech sell-off hits Wall Street, Bank of England decision on Thursday, regulatory deadlines stack up
summary: Intel, Amazon and Alphabet drag Wall Street lower as worries over artificial intelligence spending bite, while the Fed holds with two dissenters wanting a hike and the Bank of England decides on Thursday. We take stock of the regulatory deadlines facing UK investment managers, from fund liquidity rules to T plus one, and look at private credit redemptions. Three COO action points and the diary for the week.
